sources_considered.why: read_page returned full text of a Dow Jones report describing UBS's estimate. Used because the underlying UBS note was not obtained.
Search found a secondary interpretation of UBS research; the readable Dow Jones report was preferred.
read_page returned HTTP 403. Earlier financing disclosures would in any case be background, not fulfillment of the post-publication forecast.
The readable index did not expose the relevant dated financing entries; search snippets were not treated as outcome evidence.
Search result repeats and discusses the speaker's claim; it is not independent verification of the financing requirement.

evidence_items.publisher: Dow Jones, republished by Tiger Brokers
evidence_items.locator: Dow Jones report; paragraph on projected 2027–2030 capital expenditures
evidence_items.explanation: The report attributes a total additional-financing estimate to UBS, not an unqualified debt-only requirement. It also describes UBS's emphasis on customer credit and financing alternatives, so it does not establish that standalone debt borrowing is unavoidable.

metric_scope.metric: UBS estimate of additional financing required for projected capital expenditures

unresolved_gaps: The original UBS note was not obtained to verify whether it allocates the full funding need to debt.
Additional financing and debt issuance are not interchangeable metrics.
No decisive post-publication event establishes the financing mix required through 2030.
The future scale of the expansion program and its operating cash generation remain unsettled.
